name: DataTable
description: Mortar application data table, using central semantic tokens.

props.caption: string
props.columns: { key: string; label: string; render: (row: T) => ReactNode; align?: left | right; sortable?: boolean; sortValue?: (row: T) => string | number | Date | null; width?: string; truncate?: boolean }[]
props.rows: T[] where T extends { id: string }
props.sort: { key: string; direction: ascending | descending } | null

contract.usage: Import { DataTable } from @tony-ui/mortar. Without onSortChange, sortable columns sort rows locally (stable; empty values last). With onSortChange, order rows yourself (e.g. server-side) and pass sort. groupBy renders each group as its own tbody under a full-width header row spanning every column (selection included); groups keep their first-appearance order in rows and sorting applies within each group. Put Pagination in footer.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
